title: Syntagma sacrae theologiae (Liber I Cap. 2 densify)
author: Ludwig Crocius
edition: Syntagma sacrae theologiae (Bremen: Berthold Villerian, 1636). VD17 14:684303C. SLUB id335860389. Liber I Cap. 2 De S. Theologiae principiis (complete through XXIII; Cap. 3 starts PHYS 169).
blurb: Ludwig Crocius — Book I Chapter 2 On the Principles of Sacred Theology from the 1636 Bremen Latin. Complete Cap. 2 densify: principles and parts, first-and-ultimate principle, discipline genera, right reason, divine revelation as first principle, Melanchthon on certainty, analytic method, and revelation's kinds, object, and modes through immediate and mediate grades, unwritten and written Word, to Cap. 2 close. Cap. 3 De sacra Scriptura begins mid PHYS 169; the rest of the Syntagma remains.
era_note: Crocius wrote in the early seventeenth century as Reformed professor at the illustrious school of Bremen. This is not a patristic work. It is a public-domain Latin Reformed retrieval on the same Fathers-site pipeline. The 1636 Villerian folio is Public Domain Mark 1.0. Do not treat the site as ante-Nicene only.
first_english_note: No complete public-domain English of this 1636 Latin Syntagma was locked as reading text. This is a new rendering from locked Latin for Liber I Cap. 2 tip plus densify packets A-C (Cap. 2 complete).

text_history.method: English follows the locked 1636 Bremen Latin of Liber I Cap. 2 complete (tip + densify A-C through XXIII), reconstructed from SLUB Dresden page images (PHYS 152-169). Same-page OCR (tesseract lat + Vision) used as check. Melanchthon L.C. preface quotation checked against known 1559 Loci wording for the quoted stretch. No modern English was copied. Cap. 3 (CAPUT TERTIUM) begins mid PHYS 169. No Internet Archive copy was located.
